cd /tmp && cat > isox.py <<'EOF'
import sys,struct
f=open('/app/alpine.iso','rb')
SS=2048
def sect(n,c=1):
    f.seek(n*SS); return f.read(c*SS)
pvd=sect(16)
assert pvd[1:6]==b'CD001'
root=pvd[156:156+34]
def parse_dir(extent,length):
    data=b''
    n=(length+SS-1)//SS
    data=sect(extent,n)
    out=[];i=0
    while i<len(data):
        L=data[i]
        if L==0:
            i=(i//SS+1)*SS
            if i>=len(data): break
            continue
        rec=data[i:i+L]
        ext=struct.unpack('<I',rec[2:6])[0]
        size=struct.unpack('<I',rec[10:14])[0]
        flags=rec[25]
        nlen=rec[32]
        name=rec[33:33+nlen]
        out.append((name,ext,size,flags))
        i+=L
    return out
rext=struct.unpack('<I',root[2:6])[0]; rsz=struct.unpack('<I',root[10:14])[0]
entries=parse_dir(rext,rsz)
print([e[0] for e in entries])
boot=[e for e in entries if e[0].upper().startswith(b'BOOT')]
print(boot)
be=boot[0]
bd=parse_dir(be[1],be[2])
for name,ext,size,flags in bd:
    print(name,ext,size,flags)
    n=name.split(b';')[0].decode(errors='replace')
    if n.upper() in ('VMLINUZ_LTS.','INITRAMFS_LTS','VMLINUZ_LTS','INITRAMFS_LTS.','INTEL_UCODE.IMG','AMD_UCODE.IMG'):
        f.seek(ext*SS)
        open('/tmp/'+n,'wb').write(f.read(size))
        print('wrote',n,size)
EOF
